set.body: Consumer requirement PLS Neuro bd-01M2B711JWZZDY7BT7381EBDKQ, viewer completion Stage0/V1. Pinned a3ee73b AtlasQuery.exactEither gives membership, radius query computes distance to labelled voxel centres (Query.scala radiusOne), not region boundaries. Do not label that distance as a boundary distance. Native provider owns a typed nearest-boundary query with explicit coordinate space/affine metric, definition of labelled-voxel boundary, inside/outside behavior, deterministic equal-distance ties and all ties retained, finite radius/no-label/outside-radius outcomes, oblique/sheared geometry support or explicit refusal. Independent analytic affine/boundary/tie/no-label oracle and JVM+JS gates required before consumer adoption. A one-voxel label with2mm width distinguishes centre distance0 at its centre from boundary distance1mm. Consumer will expose named unavailable boundary capability until exact revision and evidence are admitted. No provider source change in this filing.
set.title: Atlas query: exact nearest labelled-region boundary distance in world millimetres
